blocks.text: Privacy policies explain how a website or app collects, stores, and uses your information. It is important to read them carefully before creating an account or agreeing to terms. By reviewing these policies, users can decide whether to share personal data or not. Students learn to check what kind of data is being collected and for what purpose. Managing privacy responsibly ensures that personal details are not shared without permission. A privacy policy tells users how their data is collected, used, stored, and shared. For example, when signing up for any social platform, the privacy policy explains what type of data may be collected, such as name, email address, location, browsing activity, and app usage. It may also explain whether this data is shared with advertisers or third-party services.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Regularly reviewing settings ensures protection as platforms update their features.
